description: 24hour-ClaudeCode lifecycle routing. SessionStart injects skill context; Stop is a prompt-based router that points Claude back to the review-loop skill.

hooks.prompt:
Use the `review-loop` skill via the Skill tool.

Execute the complete 24hour-ClaudeCode PR review loop in the current Claude Code session and current WorkTree.

Preflight git, worktree, GitHub auth, runtime config, and origin/default-branch freshness. Prove reviewable changes exist. Inspect the diff and scan for secrets. Run configured checks. Commit. Push. Bind CURRENT_HEAD_SHA in the current context. Create or refresh the PR. Wait for the current-SHA GitHub Claude Code Action review workflow. Read top-level and inline review output. Fix blocking security and correctness findings. Repeat until convergence. Merge or enable auto-merge, or report a concrete blocker.
